# SlashFrame

> Free, open-source prompt generator for AI images. Type a short idea plus slash commands (/storm, /85mm, /16:9) and get a finished prompt for Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion, Gemini, DALL-E and ChatGPT, Google Flow and Kling.

## Generators
- [Midjourney prompt generator](https://glogee.online/midjourney-prompt-generator/)
- [Flux prompt generator](https://glogee.online/flux-prompt-generator/)
- [Stable Diffusion prompt generator](https://glogee.online/stable-diffusion-prompt-generator/)
- [ChatGPT & DALL-E prompt generator](https://glogee.online/chatgpt-image-prompt-generator/)
- [Gemini prompt generator](https://glogee.online/gemini-image-prompt-generator/)
- [Google Flow prompt generator](https://glogee.online/google-flow-prompt-generator/)
- [Kling AI prompt generator](https://glogee.online/kling-prompt-generator/)

## Learn
- [How to write AI image prompts](https://glogee.online/guide/how-to-write-ai-image-prompts/)
- [Command cheat sheet](https://glogee.online/cheatsheet.html)
